review.finding: An unescaped `|` in a sub-iterate `title` shifts every later cell in that campaign.md table row under the new header-indexed column_map, silently corrupting depends_on for that row.
review.suggestion: Escape `|`/newline in title before writing the row.

review.finding: campaign_graph.py imports the module-private `_slug_from_md` from campaign_status.py across the module boundary.

remediation: Both fixed in the same sub-iterate: campaign_init.py now escapes `|`/newline in title (mirroring the repo's existing `_cell`-style pattern); parse_campaign_skeleton's own cell split was found to be independently vulnerable (a literal `stripped.split("|")` still cuts on an escaped `\|`), so an escape-aware split (_split_row_cells) was added to close both the write and read sides. _slug_from_md renamed to slug_from_md in campaign_status.py and both call sites (campaign_status.py, campaign_graph.py) updated. Verified via a new regression test (test_title_pipe_is_escaped_in_campaign_md_table), full shared/plugin test suites green, ruff clean.
